description: We are a multidisciplinary team of space enthusiasts, developers, and problem-solvers excited to participate in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Our goal is to combine creativity, open data, and technology to build innovative solutions for real-world challenges on Earth and in space
summary:
Our project involves the development of an educational and immersive video with a space-themed setting, specifically aimed at young audiences and teenagers. It is designed to take viewers on an interactive journey through the history and evolution of NASA's rovers.
We address the challenge of science communication by moving away from traditional formats and presenting information in a visual, educational, and exciting way that is tailored to young people's interests. Throughout the journey, we highlight the engineering, objectives, and most significant discoveries of the vehicles that have explored the surfaces of other celestial bodies.
The importance of this project lies in its ability to spark curiosity and foster an interest in science and technology during this formative stage of life. It also highlights how robotic exploration continues to expand the boundaries of human knowledge about the space environment we inhabit.
details:
Our project consists of an animation based on a virtual reality experience that works as an interactive timeline through space. As viewers move along the journey, they travel chronologically through the history of space exploration, encountering visual representations of NASA's different rovers. Alongside each model, its main technical specifications are clearly displayed.

The main benefit of this project is that it transforms relevant scientific information into a visually engaging, practical, and easily accessible format. Through this experience, we aim to spark curiosity, motivation, and interest in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) among children, teenagers, and young people. We hope to help them visually recognize these vehicles and understand their contributions to the study of the universe.

For the technical development, we used Delightex Edu (formerly known as CoSpaces Edu), a 3D creation and virtual reality platform that allowed us to design the space environment, animate the rovers, and program the interactive visual journey. All the documentary research and scientific data were carefully gathered from official resources provided by NASA.

The creativity behind our project lies in combining scientific accuracy with a playful and animated narrative, turning learning into a direct space exploration experience. Finally, the most important factor our team considered was that this project was designed mostly by children, for children and young people. This allowed us to adapt the language, visual pace, and interactive elements to what this audience finds engaging and appealing, creating an authentic and motivating connection among young learners.

In the video description, you will find the website link and access code to take the tour, including experiencing it in virtual reality using 3D glasses.
